name: Harrying Stance (Combat)
body:
Your shield can be used to disrupt a foe’s attack or defense.

Prerequisite(s): Shield Focus.

Benefit(s): When an opponent provokes an attack of opportunity from you, if you are using a shield you chose for Shield Focus you may make a special shield bash as an attack of opportunity. If your attack is successful, instead of dealing damage your target takes a penalty to AC or attack rolls (your choice) equal to the base shield bonus of the shield you attacked with until the beginning of your next turn. This feat grants an additional attack of opportunity per round which does not stack with the other feats that provide extra attacks of opportunity.

Special: This feat counts as Combat Reflexes for the purpose of meeting feat prerequisites and you may ignore the Dexterity requirement of any feat that has Combat Reflexes as a prerequisite.
